messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
25 அப்படியே என் ஆன்மா, இன்னும் பறந்து கொண்டிருந்தது, 26 அது பின்னோக்கி திரும்பி, அந்த கடப்பாதையை மீண்டும் பார்க்கியது 27 அது, உயிருள்ள மனிதர் ஒருபோதும் விட்டுச் செல்லாத கடப்பாதை.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | così | resultative adverb “so” | அப்படியே | “so” | OK | | l'animo | “the soul” (noun) | ஆன்மா | “soul” | OK | | mio | possessive “my” | என் | “my” | OK | | ch'ancor | relative “which still” | இன்னும் | “still” | OK | | fuggiva | imperfect “was fleeing / flying” | பறந்து கொண்டிருந்தது | “was flying” | OK | | si | reflexive clitic (no lexical meaning) | — (not expressed) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | volse | past “turned” | திரும்பி | “turned” | OK | | a (1st) | preposition of direction “to” (part of *a retro*) | பின்னோக்கி | “backward” | **UNNECESSARY** | | retro | noun used adverbially “back” | பின்னோக்கி | “backward” | OK | | a (2nd) | infinitival marker “to” (before *rimirar*) | — (not expressed) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | rimirar | infinitive “to look again” | மீண்டும் பார்க்கியது | “looked again” | OK | | lo | definite article “the” (masc.) | — (not expressed) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | passo | “the pass” (noun) | கடப்பாதையை | “the pass” | OK | | che (line 27) | relative pronoun “which / that” | அது | “that” | OK | | non | negation particle “not / never” | ஒருபோதும் | “never” | OK | | lasciò | past “left” (transitive) | விட்டுச் | “left” (as part of “விட்டுச் செல்லாத”) | OK | | già | temporal adverb “already” | — (not expressed) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | mai | adverb “never” (intensifier) | ஒருபோதும் | “never” | OK | | persona | noun “person” (feminine) | மனிதர் | “person” | OK | | viva | adjective “living” | உயிருள்ள | “living” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *si*, the two occurrences of *a* (directional and infinitival), *lo*, *già* – these elements have no direct counterpart in Tamil and are naturally omitted. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none detected.
All other source words are adequately rendered in the Tamil translation, preserving the truth‑conditions and the resultative structure of the original.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

``` அப்படியே என் ஆன்மா, இன்னும் பறந்து கொண்டிருந்தது, அது பின்னோக்கி திரும்பி அந்த கடப்பாதையை மீண்டும் பார்க்கியது அது உயிருள்ள மனிதர் ஒருபோதும் விட்டுச் செல்லாத கடப்பாதை. ```
